description: Fix all 11 P0 security, performance, API, and reliability bugs in the backend and edge worker code. Also remove all Azure OpenAI references (the project uses Azure Search built-in vectorization).
steps: STEP 1 - Issue #90 [SEC-C1]: In apps/backend/.env.shared, change JWT_SECRET default from 'super_secret_jwt_key_32_chars_min' to 'CHANGE_ME_IN_PRODUCTION_AT_LEAST_32_CHARS_LONG'. In apps/backend/app/config.py, the validator already exists (validate_production_secrets) and checks against KNOWN_PLACEHOLDER_SECRETS. Add this new default to that set if not already there. In main.py, the lifespan already logs a warning when the default is used. This is already mostly done - just ensure .env.shared uses the placeholder value that is in the KNOWN_PLACEHOLDER_SECRETS set.

STEP 2 - Issue #91 [SEC-C2]: In apps/edge/src/index.ts, modify the Turnstile section (step 3) so that for chat POST requests (url.pathname starts with '/api/v1/chat' AND request.method === 'POST'), Turnstile verification is MANDATORY (require CF-Turnstile-Response header) UNLESS the path is '/api/v1/chat/feedback' (feedback is exempted). Return 403 'Bot verification required' if missing. Keep current behavior for auth endpoints (already mandatory). Keep the optional verification for non-POST chat requests.

STEP 3 - Issue #94 [SEC-C5]: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py: (a) In get_current_user(), when Redis is unavailable for blacklist check, instead of silently passing (pass), raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail='Token validation service unavailable'). This implements fail-closed. (b) In refresh_token_endpoint(), when Redis is unavailable for revocation check, raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail='Token validation service unavailable') instead of silently passing. (c) In the logout() endpoint, make the refresh_token field required (change LogoutRequest.refresh_token from Optional[str] = None to str). Return 400 if not provided.

STEP 4 - Issue #105 [PERF-C1] + Issue #143 [RAG-C1] - Remove Azure OpenAI embedding client entirely: (a) Rewrite apps/backend/app/services/ai/embedder.py to remove ALL Azure OpenAI HTTP client logic. The new generate_embedding() should simply return the raw text string (not a vector). The search service uses Azure Search's built-in vectorization via VectorizableTextQuery which handles embedding internally. The function signature should become: async def generate_embedding(text: str) -> str, returning the sanitized text. Remove get_http_client(), close_http_client(), _get_token_provider(), and the httpx import. Remove the azure.identity imports. (b) In apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py, change from VectorizedQuery to VectorizableTextQuery. The search_context method signature should change: instead of accepting 'embedding: list[float]', accept 'text: str'. Replace VectorizedQuery(vector=embedding, ...) with VectorizableTextQuery(text=text, k_nearest_neighbors=50, fields='content_vector'). Update the import accordingly. (c) In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, update both chat() and chat_stream() endpoints: change 'embedding = await generate_embedding(sanitized_message)' to 'query_text = await generate_embedding(sanitized_message)' and pass query_text to search_service.search_context(query=..., text=query_text, ...) instead of embedding=embedding. (d) In apps/backend/app/config.py, remove the AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT field entirely. Keep AZURE_EMBEDDING_MODEL and AZURE_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS as they may be used by search index config. (e) In apps/backend/app/main.py lifespan shutdown, remove the 'from app.services.ai.embedder import close_http_client' and 'await close_http_client()' lines. (f) In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, update the RuntimeError handler to remove the 'AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT' string check.

STEP 5 - Issue #126 [API-C1]: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, the non-streaming chat() endpoint already has exception handlers. Ensure typed handlers exist: asyncio.TimeoutError -> 504 (already done), httpx.HTTPStatusError -> 502, ValueError -> 400. Add an 'except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e' block before the generic Exception handler that raises HTTPException(status_code=502, detail='Upstream service error'). Add 'except ValueError as e' that raises HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e)). Import httpx at the top of the file.

STEP 6 - Issue #127 [API-C2]: In apps/backend/app/main.py, the health router is registered at both '/health' and '/api/health'. Remove the duplicate '/api/health' registration. Add a redirect middleware or route that redirects GET /api/health -> /health and GET /api/health/deep -> /health/deep for backward compatibility. Use RedirectResponse with status_code=301.

STEP 7 - Issue #134 [CHAT-C1]: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, in the streaming endpoint (chat_stream), sanitization already happens before language detection: 'sanitized_message = sanitize_user_input(request.message)' then '_resolve_lang_and_model(request)' uses request.message (unsanitized). Fix: change _resolve_lang_and_model to accept a string argument instead of the request object, and pass sanitized_message. Update the function signature of _resolve_lang_and_model from (request: ChatRequest) to (message: str, lang_override: Optional[str] = None).

STEP 8 - Issue #159 [PAY-C1]: In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, the idempotency check already exists (using event_id and Redis). Strengthen it: (a) Validate that event_id is present and non-empty; if missing, return 400 'Missing event_id'. (b) When Redis is unavailable for the idempotency check, fail with 503 'Webhook processing unavailable' instead of silently continuing (log the error but reject the request to ensure at-least-once safety).

STEP 9 - Issue #161 [PAY-C3]: Rewrite apps/backend/app/services/comms/resend_client.py to use async httpx instead of the synchronous resend SDK with asyncio.to_thread. Create a module-level httpx.AsyncClient (lazy singleton pattern). Implement send_email() that POSTs to https://api.resend.com/emails with the API key in Authorization header. Replace send_welcome_email, send_receipt_email, send_password_reset_email to use this async client. Add a close function (close_resend_client) and register it in apps/backend/app/main.py lifespan shutdown. Remove the 'import resend' line and the top-level resend.api_key assignment.

STEP 10 - Issue #168 [OBS-C1]: Create apps/backend/app/utils/posthog.py with a get_posthog(request: Request) utility function that retrieves app.state.posthog from the request's app instance. Returns Optional[Posthog]. In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, import and use get_posthog() in both chat() and chat_stream() to capture events (e.g., 'chat_completed' with properties like lang, model, latency_ms, user_tier). Call posthog.capture() if the instance is not None.
acceptance_criteria: JWT_SECRET in .env.shared is an obvious placeholder value that exists in KNOWN_PLACEHOLDER_SECRETS
Edge worker requires Turnstile token for POST /api/v1/chat/* (except /api/v1/chat/feedback)
Auth endpoints fail closed (503) when Redis is unavailable for token blacklist/revocation checks
embedder.py no longer imports httpx or azure.identity; returns raw text
azure_search.py uses VectorizableTextQuery instead of VectorizedQuery
chat.py has typed exception handlers for HTTPStatusError (502), ValueError (400), TimeoutError (504)
Health router only registered once at /health; /api/health redirects to /health
Streaming chat endpoint sanitizes message BEFORE language detection
Razorpay webhook returns 400 when event_id missing; returns 503 when Redis unavailable for dedup
Resend client uses async httpx instead of synchronous SDK with to_thread
get_posthog() utility exists and is called in chat endpoints
No references to AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT remain in Python source files
All existing tests pass (pytest apps/backend/ with APP_ENV=test)
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya && APP_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long-for-ci MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017 pytest apps/backend/tests/ --tb=short -q
Run: grep -r 'AZURE_OPENAI' apps/backend/app/ to confirm no references remain
Run: grep -n 'VectorizableTextQuery' apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py to confirm new query type is used
Run: grep -n 'close_resend_client\|httpx.AsyncClient' apps/backend/app/services/comms/resend_client.py to confirm async client
findings: Pre-existing test failures (3): test_login_invalid_credentials (Beanie CollectionWasNotInitialized - no MongoDB), test_chat_rate_limit_returns_429 (mock returns bool instead of tuple), test_chat_error_does_not_leak_details (same mock issue). These were verified to fail on the base branch as well. Tests require AZURE_SEARCH_QUERY_KEY and AZURE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT env vars to be set (even as dummy values) for the AzureSearchService singleton to initialize at import time.
